steps.name: ready-for-turn-gate
steps.label: #btnReadyForTurn ("พร้อม..." — per-turn pass/ready gate, GameState.TURN_INTRO)
steps.why: same shape as pinocchio-luck's #ready and freeze-tap's #playerReadyBtn: the recurring per-turn gate the incoming player presses before their own screen is revealed. Reported by the same precedent-based reasoning.

steps.name: submit-number
steps.label: #btnSubmitNumber ("ล็อกคำตอบนี้ 🔒" — commits the picked number, GameState.NUMBER_ENTRY)
steps.why: the actual gameplay decision for the turn, same reasoning as pinocchio-luck's .answer buttons: arguably the more consequential control since it is what turns a pick into a locked answer. Reported as a second candidate, not chosen over the gate.
